name: OceanBase
tagline: Alipay-proven distributed SQL with MySQL (and Oracle, in Enterprise) compatibility, HTAP and vector search.
description: OceanBase is a shared-nothing distributed relational database originally built inside Ant Group to run Alipay's payment core, now developed by OceanBase as an independent company. It partitions tables across zones, replicates each partition with Paxos, and stores data in an LSM-tree engine with strong compression, which keeps storage costs low at very large scale. The open-source Community Edition is MySQL-compatible; the Enterprise Edition adds Oracle-compatible tenants, which is why it is a frequent Oracle replacement in Chinese banking. Recent 4.x/5.x releases add columnar storage, materialized views, full-text and vector search, so one cluster can cover OLTP, real-time analytics and AI retrieval.

pricing.notes: Community Edition is free; Enterprise Edition (Oracle mode, extra tooling) is licensed; OceanBase Cloud is billed per instance with trial credits.

scale.notes: Paxos-replicated partitions across zones/regions with leaders spread per partition; runs Alipay-scale workloads; multi-tenant resource isolation within a cluster.

strengths: Proven at Alipay/Double-11 scale with RPO=0 Paxos replication
LSM storage with aggressive compression cuts disk cost versus B-tree MySQL
Row and columnar storage in one engine for HTAP
Multi-tenant resource isolation inside a single cluster
Built-in vector and full-text indexes for AI retrieval
weaknesses: Oracle compatibility and some tooling are Enterprise-only
Operational tooling and much documentation are Chinese-first
Heavy minimum footprint for small deployments
Smaller Western community and ecosystem than TiDB or CockroachDB
useCases: Consolidating many MySQL instances into one multi-tenant cluster
HTAP reporting on live order data
notIdealFor: Small apps that fit on a single MySQL instance
Teams needing Oracle compatibility without an enterprise license
